title: corallorhiza hyemalis
intro: Corallorhiza hyemalis, commonly known as winter coralroot, is a rare and endangered orchid native to North America. It belongs to the Corallorhizaceae family and is known for its unique, underground relationships with fungi. The health benefits of winter coralroot include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Corallorhiza hyemalis include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
